person_note: The novel's controlling prose is third person across both sustained timelines. Authorized excerpts independently show close-third narration for Melina and Emilia, while the official guide establishes that these are the alternating whole-book strands and an explicit craft source confirms both use third person. The diagnostic quote passages agree, especially the sustained Jasper and Melina memory narration. Apparent first-person counterexamples are local speech or an embedded note, and q09478 is author's-note material; none constitutes a sustained first-person base section. The remaining uncertainty is limited to several clipped or gnomic quotes, not the book-level structure.
